coordinate_space: Each glyph ink bounding box independently normalized to 0–100, y down.
authorship: GPT-6 Sol letter groups A–I, J–R, S–Z; OpenEdit integration review
limitations: Stroke order is reconstructed from static font artwork, not recovered original pen motion.
Stroke ownership prevents a broad nib revealing later gestures; nearby intersections still depend on the authored trajectories.
Unprepared Unicode characters use whole-character reveal.
The alphabet lab is the review fixture; full glyph completion does not prove every intermediate gesture is natural.

stroke_regions.method: Nearest pen trajectory ownership, clipped to unchanged font contours
